about: Cameras in Prince's room (prince/space.py). One entry per photo.

anchor_front.status: placed as the owner remembers the shot (2026-11-16); lens: the shortest that fits, which gives a little fluffy rabbit (owner's size check)

inputs.distance: OWNER: camera to his nose 15.24 cm ('he was roughly 6 inches away from the camera'; 'it couldn't have been more than six inches away'; range 12-15.24)
inputs.height: OWNER: 'basically exactly at his eye level. Maybe just a tiny bit lower' -> his eyes 2.40 cm above the camera -- the smallest drop below his eyes at which he reaches an adult Netherland Dwarf's size (top of his head >= 12.7 cm, owner's floor)
inputs.tilt: OWNER: straight on, 'maybe looking ever so slightly up' -> tilted up 1.0 deg (range 0-2), not turned
inputs.aim: from the owner's memory: the camera aimed at his face, so its aim point in this (cropped) picture is x 548.0 (his nose), y 609.9 (the height that puts his eyes a touch above the camera); NOT the picture's centre (lesson 26)
inputs.lens: 1236.6 px: the SHORTEST lens that fits (26.0 mm-equivalent phone main camera, this picture cropped from a 3:4 frame centred on the aim point, the smallest frame that holds it); a longer lens would make him smaller still, below an adult Netherland Dwarf (owner's floor)
inputs.surface: he sat on a soft surface (his peets may sink in a little); y = 0 is that surface
inputs.peets_under_face: ASSUMED: the front of his peets is right under the front of his face

anchor_front.check: a measurement of him (width across his widest point, or height to the top of his head) would confirm the lens and his size

his_size_estimate_cm.how: rough: body taken as round; top of head and ears 3.0 cm behind his nose; check: is this the size of a little fluffy rabbit? (owner)

anchor_front.note_width: his widest outline at his nose's distance; his sides are further back, so he is wider
